author: Cleo Abram
description:
Scientists just used the James Webb Space Telescope to watch clouds change on a world over 7 lightyears away. WISE-0855 is the coldest brown dwarf we’ve ever found. We’ve known for a few years that it has icy clouds full of water, but this is the first time scientists were able to actually WATCH those clouds for 11 hours straight and collect data. 

To learn more about what they saw, subscribe! 

#Aliens #space #astronomy #weather #science

Study: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.20664
title: We Saw Alien Weather (First Time Ever)
